title: Foundations only under key structures, with a simpler game-ready tile
context: After the first story lab, the owner set the build stages (landing, foundations, solar with one Rotor, gate and walls, Stalheart, HUGIN arm, later assembly line and radar), asked for a larger rocket and a slow Isao emergence, and rejected pre-existing foundations at landing. The compute review showed the pinned Fortification tile at 2,200 triangles makes tiles the dominant cost: 563,000 triangles for the 64 x 64 m pad and about 5 million for a fully tiled 240 x 160 m base.
outcome: Foundations become islands under each key structure, sized to the structure's plot, printed by Isao as the stage begins. The owner will author a simpler game-ready foundation tile; the current Fortification tile remains an Astro-only asset. Consequences: no continuous plate, so the eight-level terrace design collapses to one locally flat pad per island with under one metre of cut and fill, and the natural lattice remains the ground between islands; the landing sequence removes the pre-tiled pad; the tile budget drops to roughly 400 tiles for the planned structures.
alternatives: Tile the whole base with the detailed tile: rejected, 5 million triangles.
Keep whole-base tiling with a low-detail field tile: not needed once foundations are islands.
Keep terrace bands across the clearing: unnecessary when each island levels only its own plot.
evidence: terrace analysis in scratch: 56 m island corner drop 0.9 m at radius 753 m
